title: Stablish
summary: STABLISH, verb transitive [Latin See Stab.] To fix; to settle in a state for permanence; to make firm. [In lieu of this, establish is now always used.]

inlines.v: STABLISH, verb transitive [Latin See Stab.] To fix; to settle in a state for permanence; to make firm. [In lieu of this, establish is now always used.]
